map.由气温与相对湿度，按 Magnus 公式反算露点温度 Td。: Back-calculate the dew point Td from the air temperature and relative humidity via the Magnus formula.
map.📖 查看「露点（Magnus 公式） 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Dew Point (Magnus Formula) User Guide"
map.露点 Td = Magnus 公式反解: Dew point Td = inverse Magnus formula
map.Magnus 经验式，适用 0–50℃ 精度良好。: The Magnus empirical formula has good accuracy from 0-50°C.
map.露点越高，空气越潮湿。: The higher the dew point, the more humid the air.
map.算露点（空气冷却到凝结的温度）。: compute the dew point (the temperature at which air cools to condensation).
map.露点高=闷、露点接近气温=快饱和要下雨。: A high dew point = muggy; a dew point close to the air temperature = nearly saturated and about to rain.
map.仓储/制药控露点防凝露。: Warehousing/pharmaceuticals control the dew point to prevent condensation.
map.25°C、相对湿度 60%：用 Magnus 式 α=(17.27×25)/(2: 25°C, relative humidity 60%: with the Magnus formula α=(17.27×25)/(237.7+25)+ln0.6 ≈1.133, dew point Td=237.7×1.133/(17.27−1.133) ≈16.7°C.
map.气温 20°C、RH 95% → 露点≈19.1°C，与气温差<1°C，极易凝露: Air temperature 20°C, RH 95% → dew point ≈19.1°C, less than 1°C from the air temperature, very prone to condensation/fog.
map.露点比气温高可能吗？: Can the dew point be higher than the air temperature?
map.不可能。露点≤气温，差越小越潮湿，差为负说明数据异常。: No. The dew point is ≤ the air temperature; the smaller the difference the more humid, and a negative difference indicates abnormal data.
map.露点有什么用？: What is the dew point used for?
map.判断结露、雾、霉变风险，也用于空调除湿目标设定（降到露点以下才凝水）。: To judge condensation, fog and mold risk, and to set the target for air-conditioning dehumidification (water only condenses below the dew point).
